title: Бытие 15 — Genesis 15
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: После этого Господь обратился к ___ в видение.
cases.translation: After this the Lord spoke to Abram in a vision.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to / toward) takes the dative → Аврааму.

cases.translation: A servant of my house will become my heir.
cases.explain: The verb стать (to become) takes its predicate noun in the instrumental → наследником.

cases.sentence: Твои потомки вернутся сюда, потому что грех ___ еще не достиг полной меры.
cases.translation: Your descendants will return here, for the sin of the Amorites has not yet reached its full measure.
cases.explain: Possession — the sin of the Amorites — is expressed by the genitive plural → Амореев.

cases.translation: Do not be afraid, Abram; I am your shield.
cases.explain: Predicate of “I am…” with the present-tense “to be” omitted stays nominative → щит.

cases.sentence: Твои потомки будут странниками в чужой ___.
cases.translation: Your descendants will be strangers in a land not their own.
cases.explain: В marking a location (no motion) takes the prepositional → земле.

cases.sentence: Приведи мне трехлетнюю ___, трехлетнюю козу и трехлетнего барана.
cases.translation: Bring me a three-year-old heifer, a three-year-old goat, and a three-year-old ram.
cases.explain: Direct object of приведи (bring) → accusative; feminine -а becomes -у.

cases.translation: I give this land to your descendants.
cases.explain: The recipient of отдаю (give) goes in the dative → потомкам.

cases.translation: A smoking brazier appeared with a blazing torch.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) takes the instrumental → факелом.

reading.ru: Не бойся, Авраам, я твой щит, награда твоя будет весьма велика.
reading.question: How did the Lord reassure Abram in the vision?
options: He is Abram's shield and reward
He would take him to Egypt
reading.correct: He is Abram's shield and reward
reading.explain: The Lord told Abram not to fear, saying He is his shield and his very great reward.

reading.ru: Авраам поверил Господу, и он вменил ему это в праведность.
reading.question: What was credited to Abram as righteousness?
reading.explain: Abram believed the Lord, and it was credited to him as righteousness.

reading.ru: Приведи мне трехлетнюю телицу, трехлетнюю козу и трехлетнего барана, а также принеси горлицу и молодого голубя.
reading.question: Which animals did the Lord tell Abram to bring?
options: A heifer, a goat, a ram, a turtledove, and a pigeon
reading.correct: A heifer, a goat, a ram, a turtledove, and a pigeon
reading.explain: The Lord asked for a three-year-old heifer, goat, and ram, plus a turtledove and a young pigeon.

reading.ru: При заходе солнца Авраама охватил глубокий сон, и тут кромешная тьма опустилась, и ужас объял его.
reading.question: What came over Abram as the sun was setting?
options: A deep sleep, darkness, and terror
reading.correct: A deep sleep, darkness, and terror
reading.explain: As the sun set, a deep sleep fell on Abram, and dense darkness and terror came over him.

reading.ru: В четвертом поколении твои потомки вернутся сюда, потому что грех Амореев еще не достиг полной меры.
reading.question: When would Abram's descendants return to the land?
reading.explain: The Lord said they would come back in the fourth generation, once the Amorites' sin was complete.

reading.ru: Он вывел его наружу и сказал, взгляни на небеса и сосчитай звезды, если можешь их сосчитать, и сказал ему, таким будет твое потомство.
reading.question: To what did the Lord compare Abram's future offspring?
reading.explain: The Lord told Abram to count the stars — so numerous would his offspring be.
